author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Side-view trumpet: leadpipe, flat r8 stadium tube loop hanging below it, three valve pistons 8 apart, cone bell with vertical mouth. Reads as a trumpet at 48 in both themes. Lucide: no trumpet; built from Lucide stadium/line construction.
omissions: Mouthpiece tick dropped (no room at 8 spacing from the loop); valves drawn as pistons above the leadpipe instead of crossing the loop (crossing lines cannot keep 8 apart inside the loop).
